2608.02397.title: Can Foundation Models Hear What Made That Sound? A Tiered Benchmark of Audio-Language Models and Traditional Classifiers for Closed-Set Sound Source Identification
2608.02397.paper_summary: We benchmark eleven audio classification methods: five task-aware closed-set LLMs (four Gemini models plus open-weight Kimi-Audio-7B-Instruct), four fixed-vocabulary taggers (YAMNet, PANNs, Whisper-AT, and SSLAM), a zero-shot audio-text model (CLAP), and an audio-grounded LLM (BAT). We evaluate them on a closed-set sound-source identification task over 2,242 clips spanning 23 fine-grained classes and 11 categories. Since these methods differ fundamentally in how they receive the task and how outputs are scored, we group them into four evaluation tiers rather than one leaderboard, reporting macro Precision, Recall, F1, and false-negative rate per tier. The best model, Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview, reaches 85.6 percent category-level F1 and 56.7 percent fine-grained F1. Kimi-Audio is competitive for its size, reaching 67.5 percent category-level F1 and 32.9 percent fine-grained F1, but fails to answer 1.6 percent of samples. SSLAM and CLAP match or exceed the best closed-set model at the category level without seeing the candidate list, but fall behind at the fine-grained level. Analyzing the Gemini models' chain-of-thought across 8,968 responses, we find that response length does not predict accuracy, an apparent "holistic judgment beats detailed analysis" effect is better explained as a difficulty confound, and wrong answers are stated confidently 92 to 100 percent of the time. We report full per-class confusion matrices and metrics for all eleven methods, identify the structural error modes behind most of the accuracy loss between granularities, and give practical guidance for choosing among these method families.
2608.02397.paper_summary_zh: 我們基準測試了十一種音頻分類方法：五種任務感知的封閉集 LLM（四個 Gemini 模型加上開放權重的 Kimi-Audio-7B-Instruct）、四個固定詞彙標籤器（YAMNet、PANNs、Whisper-AT 和 SSLAM）、一個零-shot 音頻-文本模型（CLAP），以及一個音頻基礎的 LLM（BAT）。我們在一個封閉集的聲音來源識別任務上評估它們，涵蓋 2,242 段音頻，跨越 23 個細粒度類別和 11 個類別。由於這些方法在接收任務的方式和輸出評分的方式上根本不同，我們將它們分為四個評估層級，而不是一個排行榜，並報告每個層級的宏觀精確率、召回率、F1 值和假陰性率。最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 達到 85.6% 的類別級 F1 和 56.7% 的細粒度 F1。Kimi-Audio 在其大小上具有競爭力，達到 67.5% 的類別級 F1 和 32.9% 的細粒度 F1，但未能回答 1.6% 的樣本。SSLAM 和 CLAP 在類別級別上與最佳的封閉集模型相匹配或超過，且未查看候選列表，但在細粒度級別上落後。分析 Gemini 模型在 8,968 個回應中的思考鏈，我們發現回應長度無法預測準確性，顯然的「整體判斷勝過詳細分析」效應更好地解釋為一種困難混淆，且錯誤答案以 92% 到 100% 的信心陳述。我們報告所有十一種方法的完整每類混淆矩陣和指標，識別大多數準確性損失在不同粒度之間的結構性錯誤模式，並提供選擇這些方法家族的實用指導。
